Title: Ajay's Day

Cast

1. Ajay - 34 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Kavita - 62 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Anil - 32 years, friend
Look: blue shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The fields - a wheat crop, a neem tree
2. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights

Scene 1: The fields - Day

[Ajay stands in the fields. Kavita stands near him.]

Ajay: "Today feels like a good day."

[Ajay ploughs the field.]

Ajay: "Oh wow!"

[Ajay harvests the wheat with a sickle.]

Kavita: "That's easy."

[Ajay rests under the tree in the shade.]

Ajay (laughing): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Ajay wipes his brow in the hot sun.]

Kavita (softly): "Good job, Ajay!"

Scene 2: The main road - Day

[Ajay stands on the road. Kavita stands near him.]

Ajay: "So, here we are!"

[Ajay's bike skids on the wet road and he falls off.]

Kavita: "That's easy."

[Ajay's car crashes into a pole.]

Ajay (laughing): "I'm ready!"

[A dog runs in front of Ajay's car; he brakes hard and swerves just in time.]

Kavita: "Ajay, are you okay?"

[Ajay loses his balance on the bicycle and falls.]

Kavita (surprised): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
